subject: Post-demo: logs & backups — retention, restore windows, and next steps
content:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Kaplan <alex.kaplan@medicorehealth.com>, Security Ops <ops+security@medicorehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: logs & backups — retention, restore windows, and next steps

Alex / Security team — thanks again for the demo time today. Quick recap and a suggested set of next steps so we can close the compliance checklist on retention and deletion: 

1) Clarify scope we need evidence for:
   - Application logs (request/response traces) and their live TTL
   - Snapshot backups (daily snapshots of tenant volumes) — retention and purge behavior
   - Audit logs / admin action logs — retention and access controls

2) Key questions for Medicore we need answered to finish qualification:
   - Are you pursuing SOC 2 Type II or Type I? (you mentioned Type II in progress — estimate?)
   - Any contractual maximum for deletion/erase requests (e.g., GDPR erasure windows)?
   - Do backups need to be considered in scope for erasure requests or is destruction on snapshot rotation acceptable?

3) What we can provide today:
   - Redwood standard deletion flow: logical deletion within 24h of request and snapshot expiration policy. We will outline tiered options (30/60/90 day physical purge windows) and provide an attestation for process once SOC 2 report is available.
   - Compliance pack (attached) and a vendor questionnaire we ask you to complete so we can map controls line-by-line.

Attachments: redwood-security-pack.pdf, vendor-security-questionnaire.xlsx

Proposed next steps:
- Alex: please share any existing retention policy PDFs or DPA clauses you want us to map to (upload to the Drive link above).
- Medicore Security: confirm target SOC 2 timeline.
- Redwood: we’ll propose three deletion-SLA tiers and call out impacts to cost and restore windows.

I’ve looped Ben and Monica for pricing/legal impacts and for a short 30-min follow-up tomorrow to walk the team through options. If you prefer, we can target a call Thurs 9/16.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0136

-----

From: Alex Kaplan <alex.kaplan@medicorehealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Security Ops <ops+security@medicorehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 17:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-demo: logs & backups — retention, restore windows, and next steps

Thanks Jasmine — appreciate the clear summary. Quick answers from Medicore side: 

- SOC 2: We are currently in progress on Type II; target completion Q1 2028. We can share interim evidence but the full report will be available after the audit window (Feb 2028).
- Erasure SLA: Our legal team prefers a maximum 30-day window to remove personal data from all systems. We realize backups are often a separate constraint — we need clarity on whether Redwood will treat backups as in-scope for the 30-day erasure or if we accept a delayed purge from backups.
- Backups: Attached is our existing retention policy (medicore-log-policy.pdf). We retain point-in-time snapshots for 90 days and full backups for 1 year unless otherwise flagged for legal hold.

Request: can Redwood provide a short write-up that distinguishes: (A) logical deletion from primary systems, (B) snapshot expiration vs physical sanitization, and (C) options for faster backup purging if we require it (and associated costs)?

I will have our security ops complete the vendor questionnaire — could you confirm the preferred return format (spreadsheet or DocuSign)? Also please include the contact in Redwood legal for DPA review.

— Alex
Alex Kaplan | Head of Security Engineering | Medicore Health
alex.kaplan@medicorehealth.com

Attachment: medicore-log-policy.pdf

-----

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Short note — agree we need to be explicit here. Negotiation play: offer standard logical-delete 24h + snapshot expiry default 90d; for enterprise medial deals we can offer a 30d backup purge SLA as a paid compliance add-on (or as part of Dedicated capacity commitments). Loop Legal early for DPA sample language. Monica — can you draft a 30/60/90 options table we can send tomorrow?

Ben
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Kaplan <alex.kaplan@medicorehealth.com>, Security Ops <ops+security@medicorehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 08:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-demo: logs & backups — retention, restore windows, and next steps

Alex — thanks for the quick answers and for the policy PDF. A few clarifications and concrete options so your legal/security can review offline: 

- Our deletion flow (summary):
  * Stage 1 — Logical deletion from live tenant store: target 24 hours after a validated erasure request. (Immediate access revoked; data not returned via API.)
  * Stage 2 — Snapshot handling: snapshots are immutable point-in-time copies. Default: snapshots expire on their scheduled rotation (30/90 days depending on your tenant profile). When a deletion request includes backup data, we flag snapshots and ensure that on next rotation they are excluded from future restorations; physical media overwrite/eradication follows the snapshot retention window.
  * Stage 3 — Physical purge: target window for physical removal from backup media depends on tier: Standard = 90 days, Accelerated = 60 days, Expedited = 30 days (enterprise add-on). We can include a contractual SLA for Accelerated/Expedited with associated pricing.

- Evidence / attestation: once your SOC 2 Type II is completed we can provide a mapping of Redwood controls and our standard attestation language. In the interim we can provide configuration screenshots/exports and the compliance pack we attached earlier.

- DPA & legal: Redwood legal contact for DPA/clauses is legal-contacts@redwood.ai (I’ll include them on the next thread if you want to start redlines).

I’ve attached a short spreadsheet with deletion-SLA options and an estimated cost delta per month depending on snapshot retention (deletion-sla-options.xlsx). Could you please: 
  1) Confirm whether Medicore will require backups to be fully purged within 30 days (we can do that as Expedited add-on), and
  2) Have Security Ops complete vendor-security-questionnaire.xlsx by EOD 9/21 so we can map controls ahead of the SOC 2 report.

Open to a quick call to walk through the options — Ben, Monica, can we offer Thurs 9/16 10am PT or Fri 9/17 9am PT?

Thanks again,
Jasmine

-----

From: Alex Kaplan <alex.kaplan@medicorehealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Security Ops <ops+security@medicorehealth.com>

Subject: Re: Post-demo: logs & backups — retention, restore windows, and next steps

Jasmine — that level of detail is perfect. We’ll aim to return the questionnaire by 2027-09-21. For now, Medicore legal prefers to keep backups in-scope but accepts a 30-day physical purge only for accelerated/expedited-paid tier. We are OK to review pricing.

I’ll also get Legal to reach out to legal-contacts@redwood.ai to start DPA redlines. Please send the 9/16 slot invite if that works for Redwood.

Alex
